nodes.Name: Regexp
nodes.DocComment: A Regexp is a node in a regular expression syntax tree.

nodes.Name: Op
nodes.DocComment: An Op is a single regular expression operator.

nodes.Name: Equal
nodes.DocComment: Equal reports whether x and y have identical structure.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: x.Flags&NonGreedy != y.Flags&NonGreedy || x.Min != y.Min || x.Max != y.Max || !x.Sub[0].Equal(y.Sub[0])

nodes.Name: printFlags
nodes.DocComment: printFlags is a bit set indicating which flags (including non-capturing parens) to print around a regexp.

nodes.Name: addSpan
nodes.DocComment:
addSpan enables the flags f around start..last,
by setting flags[start] = f and flags[last] = flagOff.

nodes.Name: calcFlags
nodes.DocComment:
calcFlags calculates the flags to print around each subexpression in re,
storing that information in (*flags)[sub] for each affected subexpression.
The first time an entry needs to be written to *flags, calcFlags allocates the map.
calcFlags also calculates the flags that must be active or can't be active
around re and returns those flags.

Children.Name: if
Children.RawSource: minFold <= r && r <= maxFold && unicode.SimpleFold(r) != r

nodes.Name: writeRegexp
nodes.DocComment: writeRegexp writes the Perl syntax for the regular expression re to b.

nodes.Name: MaxCap
nodes.DocComment: MaxCap walks the regexp to find the maximum capture index.

nodes.Name: CapNames
nodes.DocComment: CapNames walks the regexp to find the names of capturing groups.
